name: Kiku Enomoto
designNotes:

ANCESTRY, ancestry twist requested by Ingram, ancestry chosen by me (2026-09-29): Dwarf, checked against data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json ('short, squat, and hardy... take great pride in their traditions', terrestrial: true) -- fits a woman who built this place herself and runs it exactly her own way.

Her real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file: "Proposed: level 2, a working adult, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists." Not carried into this file's `statblock` field for that reason.
status: established and voiced (the Paper Lantern haunt is built and playable) -- first regular of the new haunt formalized into a real npc file

facts.text: More uniforms every season, more sweeps after curfew, and she isn't sure how much longer she can keep this room the way it's always been.
